reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 07 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution face/collar crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

entries.positive_observation: The dark navy peaked cap with gold front insignia and gold visor ornament remains, with hair mostly covered and dark eyebrows visible. The face has one restrained closed mouth, a smooth chin and no moustache, beard or spectacles. The nearly frontal capped head angles subtly toward viewer left, with a slightly left gaze, squared shoulders, chest-up crop, subdued frontal light and strong visor shadow. The dark navy jacket, white pointed shirt collar, one dark tie and one visible gold shoulder board at lower viewer left remain. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk, clipping or cream bib. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque muted gray-olive photographic backing, overlapping warm-cream note with two compact upper gray-mark rows and mostly blank lower paper, and small right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte outer ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette. Actual white/cyan/alpha inspection found no visible holes or missing backing; 252-254 alpha values were not used as a rejection shortcut. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: At 65x67 the exact cap badge, visor ornament and shoulder embroidery cannot be transcribed, and note glyphs are indistinct; visible metallic colors, placements, counts and two-row upper-note footprint were checked without claiming microscopic identity.
